verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a per-state compliance dashboard that shows upcoming deadlines for each state, and says it tracks all compliance requirements and deadlines and files annual reports and franchise tax reports for you. However, nothing documents proactive alerts or notifications (email, reminders, lead times) sent ahead of those deadlines, so the alerting core of the story is only implied by dashboard visibility. Missing for 10: documented proactive deadline notifications with advance lead time, explicit coverage of every state where Firstbase is registered agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of the alerts.
